newsitem.title: USA: CapStar files with SEC for 5 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: CapStar files with SEC for 5 mln shares.

text.p: CapStar Hotel Co Thursday filed a registration with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to five million common shares.

The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 750,000 additional common shares, the filng said. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 17,754,321 common.
The offering will be made through Lehman Brothers, BT Securities Corp, Goldman Sachs & Co, Merrill Lynch & Co, Montgomery Securities and Smith Barney Inc.

Net proceeds will be used to fund the acquisition of the Highgate Portfolio and the additional acquisitions, to retire outstanding balances under the credit facility and for general corporate purposes.

The company has entered into contracts to acquire a portfolio of six hotels which contain 1,358 rooms (the Highgate Portfolio) and two additional hotels containing 367 rooms (the additional acquisitions).
CapStar, based in Washington DC, is a hotel management and investment company which acquires, renovates, repositions and manages hotels throughout the United States.
